question_text: What is 'False Sharing' in multi-threaded concurrent programming on multi-core processors?

options.text: Two threads accessing different variables that reside on the same CPU cache line, causing constant invalidation traffic
Threads sharing heap pointers without atomic increments
Corrupted virtual memory pages mapped to multiple processes
Operating system scheduler swapping threads onto wrong NUMA nodes

answer_explanation: Even if threads modify independent variables, if those variables share a 64-byte cache line, CPU cache coherence protocols (MESI) invalidate the entire line on every write.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: Even if threads modify independent variables, if those variables share a 64-byte cache line, CPU cache coherence protocols (MESI) invalidate the entire line on every write.
